meta.name: add-discord
meta.description: Add Discord bot channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 集成 Discord 机器人频道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加 Discord 机器人消息通道。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Discord bot channels into your app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add a Discord bot channel to your application.

howto.what: 把 Discord 机器人适配器复制进项目，注册并安装依赖，引导你粘贴 Bot Token 并生成配置，重启后你的 Discord 机器人就能通过私信或频道与 Claude 对话。
howto.when: 当你要求给 NanoClaw 添加 Discord 机器人频道集成时触发，比如说“接入 Discord”、“添加 Discord 频道”等。

say.text: 给我的 NanoClaw 添加 Discord 机器人频道。
say.note: 会引导你创建机器人并粘贴 Token。

say.text: 接入 Discord，用我自己的机器人账号。
say.note: 自动复制适配器、注册并配置。

say.text: 把 Discord 集成到我的服务里。
say.note: 执行安装、构建、验证和重启。

howto.what_en: Adds the Discord bot adapter to the project, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, and guides you through pasting the Bot Token so the bot can chat with Claude over Discord DMs or channels.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add Discord bot integration to NanoClaw, e.g. "add Discord" or "integrate Discord".

say_en.text: Add a Discord bot channel to my NanoClaw.
say_en.note: Guides you through creating the bot and pasting the token.

say_en.text: Integrate Discord using my existing bot.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, and sets up credentials.

say_en.text: Set up Discord integration for my service.
say_en.note: Runs install, build, validation, and restart.
